title: optimize-evals-review-prep-2026-03-04
content:
Meeting: Optimize / Evals review (prep notes)
Date: 2026-03-04 weekly sync (30m)
Attendees (planned): Casey, Jamie, Nina, Miguel, Samir
Purpose: quick triage of quality regressions surfaced in last A/B run, decide next steps for prompt set updates and rollback policy

Agenda (30m)
- 0-5m: quick framing and what triggered this review (alert summary)
- 5-15m: A/B results deep-dive (v2.1 -> v2.2)
  - primary signals: pass@k for instruction tasks, QA-pass rate, hallucination score (LM halluc metric), throughput/latency unchanged
  - failing slices: long-form summarization (>=800 tokens), instruction-following for math prompts, finance domain factuality
- 15-22m: prompt set evaluation and candidate fixes (prompt engineering, few-shot examples, dynamic system message)
- 22-28m: rollout decision and action items (canary rollback, patch release, follow-up evals)
- 28-30m: sync on owners and next check-in

Current trigger / context
- Last A/B ended 2026-03-02. Metric drift: QA-pass down 4.6% absolute on v2.2 vs v2.1 (stat sig p<0.01). Hallucination score increased for finance prompts (slice id FIN-03).
- Spike coincides with model compile change (kernel selection tweak) deployed 2026-02-28 — possible perf vs quality trade-off.
- Customer reports: two support tickets referencing worse factuality in finance summarization (CS-5401, CS-5403).

Key data to have in meeting (prep checklist)
- A/B dashboard link and the specific slice filters (attached in linked_artifacts)
- 8–10 failing examples (gold vs outputs) — I pulled a short sample into the eval dashboard notes
- Diff of config: runtime compile flags between v2.1 and v2.2 (ask SRE/RE to confirm)
- Previous prompt-set used for finance summarization (prompt-set id ps-finance-v3)

Hypotheses (brainstorm)
1) Kernel/compile change altered decoding behavior on longer contexts -> more hallucinations on finance summaries.
2) Prompt sensitivity: v2.2 parameterization interacts poorly with system message in ps-finance-v3.
3) Dataset shift in evaluation harness (we introduced new hard finance cases last run) -> amplifies regression but not model change alone.

Proposed checks (fast, cheap)
- Re-run failing slice with v2.1 but with v2.2 compile flags (if possible) to isolate compile vs weights. Owner: Miguel.
- Run v2.2 with an augmented system message (explicit "verify facts; cite sources") on a small batch (100 cases) to see if prompt mitigates. Owner: Nina.
- Evaluate throughput/latency to ensure no trade-off masking. Owner: Samir to confirm infra metrics.

Candidate short-term mitigations
- If prompt fix recovers >3% QA-pass on slice, deploy prompt patch to canary (10% traffic) and monitor for 24–48h.
- If compile flag suspected, rollback compile tweak for finance customers / canary and run controlled A/B.
- If neither helps, escalate to model team for a micro-patch or revert to v2.1 for the fleet.

Action items (concrete)
- Miguel: attempt the compile-flag isolation test and share results in thread by EOD 2026-03-04.
- Nina: run prompt augmentation experiment (100-case) and post summary with example diffs by 2026-03-05 morning.
- Samir: pull infra metrics (latency, GPU utilization) for both versions and confirm no resource anomaly by EOD 2026-03-04.
- Casey: prepare canary rollout plan (including rollback playbook) and update Confluence page if we choose canary; draft PR for prompt change if needed. Due 2026-03-05 noon.
- Jamie: loop in DS/model owner (TBD) and request quick triage if we see no improvement from above.

Notes to self / scratches
- Keep examples short in meeting, show 3 high-visibility cases + summary numbers
- Avoid blaming "compile" until Miguel's isolation test — frame as "two actionable levers: runtime config vs prompt"
- Check linked JIRA for prior related regressions (JIRA-OPT-1010)

Follow-up cadence
- Quick async updates in thread as experiments finish.
- 1 follow-up sync (15m) Wednesday 2026-03-06 if we need rollout decision.

Open questions
- Do we have a reliable metric for "hallucination" we trust across domains? If not, avoid over-weighing that signal.
- Which customers are on dedicated vs hosted? If dedicated, compile rollback impact differs. Jamie to confirm.

Draft message for the meeting start (copy/paste)
"Hi team — quick sync to triage the QA-pass drop on v2.2 from the last A/B. I’ll share the top 10 failing examples, Miguel will attempt a compile isolation run, Nina will try prompt augmentation, and Samir will confirm infra metrics. Goal: decide by EOD tomorrow whether to canary a prompt fix or revert compile changes for affected slices."

End of notes.

(Temp scratch: ticket refs to paste into convo: CS-5401, CS-5403, JIRA-OPT-1187, JIRA-OPT-1010)
